new_statements.quote: There are no peculiarities of accent beyond a slight drawl at the end of a sentence. The pronunciation is level and even, though somewhat indistinct, the words short and simple, and the general effect of the language on the ear is soft and musical.
new_statements.citation: Beames, John. 1870. Art. IV. On the Magar Language of Nepal. Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society of Great Britain and Ireland, New Series 4: 178-228.
new_statements.locator: Section II.1 'Sounds', p. 190 (archive.org journalofroyalas4187roya, leaf 202 = PDF page 202)

new_statements.rule_in_words: Beames reports no noticeable word accent at all: pronunciation is 'level and even', the only prominence effect being a slight lengthening ('drawl') at the end of a sentence. No syllable is singled out as stressed, so no placement rule can be extracted.
new_statements.exceptions: none; the only qualification is the sentence-final drawl
new_statements.domain_note: Impressionistic 1870 remark in a 'Sounds' section, covering connected speech as a whole (sentence-final drawl is phrase-level); not a phonological analysis. The two 20th-century analyses that were readable are silent: Subba 1972 (p. 3) states outright that accent and intonation were not studied, and the SIL-based Magar note in Hale 1973 (pp. 18-19) discusses breathiness and pitch lowering but says nothing about stress. The modern reference grammar (Grunow-Hårsta 2008) could not be opened.
new_statements.first_reading: no word stress according to the source
new_statements.identity_note: Beames 1870 (the quoted source) worked with two Magar soldiers supplied by Jung Bahadur through the Kathmandu Residency and does not name their home district; Glottolog files the sketch under east2352 (Eastern Magar, mgp). The other readable descriptions are also eastern: Subba 1972's principal informant is from Rising, Tanahu; the SIL note in Hale 1973 (after Shepherd & Shepherd 1971) describes Yanchok, Tanahu; Baskaran 2009 describes Sikkim 'Mangari'. Western Magar (Palpa/Syangja/Rolpa etc.) is west2418 [mrd], audited separately in../west2418.
